DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 参加されるのはお子様ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your child the one taking part?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。名前の欄に私の名前を書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 参加者名の記入ミスを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I accidentally wrote my own name in the name field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the mistake in the participant's name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 参加者の欄はこちらです。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 子供の名前に直します。私は付き添いとして書けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子供名へ訂正し付き添い欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll change it to my child's name. Should I list myself as the accompanying adult?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct it to the child's name and ask about the accompanying adult field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 付き添いの扱いは担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check with the person in charge about accompanying adults.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 連絡先は私の電話番号を使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保護者の連絡先を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to use my phone number as the contact number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify the guardian's contact details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 参加者名と連絡先の名義を分けて記してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please enter the participant's name separately from the contact person's name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分けました。子供自身の電話番号はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 名義を分け電話の有無を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've separated them. My child doesn't have a phone number of their own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate the names and explain whether the child has a phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 当日の参加人数も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll also check how many people will be there on the day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 子供一人と保護者一人です。参加枠と付き添いを分けて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 参加枠と付き添い人数を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: One child and one guardian. I'll discuss the participant place and the accompanying adult separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the participant place from the number of accompanying adults. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その二人の役割を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll check those two people's roles with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の前に眼鏡を外していただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'll need to remove your glasses before the examination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 外すと足元が見えにくいので、移動のときに声をかけてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 視界の不自由と移動補助を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I take them off, I can't see where I'm stepping clearly. Could someone speak to me to guide me when I move?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your difficulty seeing and request help moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当者に伝えます。ケースはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll let the person in charge know. Do you have a case?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。机へ直接置かず、このケースへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 眼鏡をケースに保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I'll put them in this case instead of directly on the desk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Store your glasses in their case. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだこちらで待っていてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please keep waiting here for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 呼ばれるまでは眼鏡を掛けて待ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 外す時点を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I keep my glasses on while I wait until I'm called?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check when to take your glasses off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 外す時点を担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check with the person in charge when you should take them off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分で検査室へ歩き出さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 単独で移動を始めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll make sure I don't start walking to the examination room by myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you won't start moving on your own. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ケースも一緒にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please bring the case along too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: かばんの前のポケットに入れて、すぐ出せるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ケースを取り出せる場所に置く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put it in the front pocket of my bag so I can get it out quickly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put the case somewhere you can retrieve it easily. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 移動時の補助と外す時点を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell the person in charge about the help you need when moving and when to remove your glasses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような投稿があったのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of post was it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族で使うアカウントから、覚えのない宣伝が出ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 共有アカウントの不審投稿を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An advertisement I don't recognize was posted from the account my family shares.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a suspicious post on a shared account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族は全員確認されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked with everyone in your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ兄には聞けていません。誰かに乗っ取られたとは言い切れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族未確認と断定不可を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't been able to ask my older brother yet. I can't say for certain that someone has taken over the account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you haven't checked with the whole family and cannot draw a definite conclusion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見つけた時刻と内容は残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have a record of its content and when you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 画面を保存しました。投稿を見つけた時刻も書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 画面と発見時刻の記録を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I saved a screenshot. I also wrote down when I found the post.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the screenshot and the record of when you discovered the post. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 金銭の被害は確認できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you confirmed any financial loss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今のところ確認できていません。支払いについても家族と確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金銭被害の未確認を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't confirmed any so far. I'll check with my family about payments too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that financial loss has not been confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 相談内容として、その未確認の部分も記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll record those unconfirmed points as part of your consultation too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 兄の返事と支払いの確認結果が出たら、事実を追加して相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加の確認結果を報告すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once my brother replies and we've checked the payments, I'll add those facts when I consult you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to report the additional findings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、まず保存した画面から伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's start with the screenshot you saved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この封筒は閉じる前ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You haven't sealed this envelope yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。写真三枚と手紙を入れますが、どの説明がどの写真か分かりづらいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 写真と説明の対応不足を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: That's right. I'm putting in three photos and a letter, but it's hard to tell which explanation goes with which photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the photos and explanations are not clearly matched. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真の裏に印を付けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Can you mark the backs of the photos?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 番号を付けて、手紙にも同じ番号を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 共通番号を付ける案を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll number them and write the same numbers in the letter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Suggest using matching numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表の写真に書かないよう気を付けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Be careful not to write on the front of the photos.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 裏の端に一、二、三と書きました。手紙の順も合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真裏と手紙の番号をそろえる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've written one, two and three along the edges on the back. I'll put the letter in the same order too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Match the numbers on the backs of the photos to those in the letter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 重ねる順は決まりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided what order to stack them in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号順にして、手紙を上に置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封筒内の順番を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put them in numerical order with the letter on top.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide the order of the contents in the envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 中身がそろってから封をしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please seal it once all the contents are together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三枚と一通を確認しました。この封筒を閉じて出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 枚数を確認し封して出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked that there are three photos and one letter. I'll seal this envelope and send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the number of items, seal the envelope and send it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、準備できた封筒で発送を承ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll accept the prepared envelope for mailing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの料金の口座振替をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Which charges would you like to pay by direct debit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 電気と習い事の二つです。この用紙で両方申し込めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二つの支払先の申込みを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Electricity and my lessons, so two payments. Can I apply for both using this form?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about applying for two different payees. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 支払先ごとに申込方法を確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the application method for each payee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、この用紙がどちら用か先に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 用紙の対象を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then please tell me first which one this form is for.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify what the form applies to. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは電気の申込用です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is the application for electricity payments.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 習い事の分は、教室に用紙を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別の支払先へ方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check with the class about the form for my lessons.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the procedure with the other payee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 引落しを始める時期も別に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check separately when the debits will start.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 申し込んだだけで次の支払いが自動になるとは考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 申込と開始を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll make sure I don't assume the next payment will be automatic just because I've applied.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish applying from the start of the service. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今までの支払い案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have your existing payment instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。開始の確認が取れるまで、二つの案内を別々に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 従来の支払い案内を各々保持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll keep the two sets of instructions separately until the start has been confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the existing payment instructions for each payee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、電気の用紙から記入内容を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's check the details on the electricity form first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 袋詰めはお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished packing your bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 贈り物の袋に、自宅用の冷蔵品を入れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 袋への冷蔵品混入を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I accidentally put refrigerated items for home in the gift bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that refrigerated items got mixed into the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分ける袋はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have another bag to separate them into?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自宅用の保冷袋があります。そちらへ移します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自宅用の保冷袋へ移す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have an insulated bag for home. I'll move them into that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Move the items into the insulated bag for home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 贈り物はどの商品ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この焼き菓子二つです。ほかは自宅用です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 贈る商品を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: These two baked treats. Everything else is for home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify exactly which items are gifts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋の中をもう一度見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check inside the bag once more.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 冷蔵品を移して、二つだけになりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋の中身の分離を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've moved the refrigerated items, so only the two gifts are left.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that you've separated the contents of the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: レシートも渡す予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Are you planning to give them the receipt too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全部の買い物が載っているので、私が保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全品のレシートを手元に保管する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: It lists all my shopping, so I'll keep it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the receipt covering all the items with you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、二つの袋を取り違えずにお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take both bags home without mixing them up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 六人で組を作りますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: We'll make groups with six people, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一人は見学です。私が参加人数に入れてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見学者を参加数から外す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: One person is just watching. I accidentally counted them as a participant.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Exclude the observer from the participant count. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、実際に参加するのは五人ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: So five people will actually take part, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。見学の友人には荷物の近くで待ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 参加人数と見学者の居場所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I'll have my friend who's watching wait near our belongings.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the participant count and where the observer will be. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 奇数なので、交代する人を決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Since there's an odd number, let's decide who will take turns sitting out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最初は私が記録係になって、次の回に入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 奇数人数での交代役を引き受ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll keep the records first and join in the next round.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Volunteer for the rotating role with an odd number of participants. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 結果を書いた紙はどこに置きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Where will you put the sheet with the results?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 風で飛ばないよう、板に挟んでベンチの上で書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記録用紙の管理を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll clip it to a board so it doesn't blow away and write on it on the bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain how you'll manage the record sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 途中から参加したい人がいたら教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please let me know if anyone wants to join partway through.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人に確認してから、人数と交代順を更新します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 途中参加は本人確認後に更新する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check with them first, then update the headcount and rotation order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Update the count and rotation for someone joining partway through only after checking with them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、五人の参加と今の交代順で始めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's start with five participants and the current rotation order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れ様はもう移動されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your companion moving on now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。その前に、貸した充電器を返してもらいましたが、本体が見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 貸した充電器の一部不足を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Before that, they returned the charger I lent them, but I can't find the main unit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that part of the charger you lent is missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 返ってきたのはコードだけですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。席のコンセントに本体が残っているかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未回収の本体の場所を推測として示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The main unit may still be in the outlet by the seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Suggest where the uncollected main unit might be, making clear it is a guess. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 持ち主と確認してから外してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check with the owner before unplugging it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人と元の席へ戻って、私の物か確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 借りた本人と確認すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll go back to our original seats with my friend and check whether it's mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide to check together with the person who borrowed it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの方の物には触れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please don't touch anyone else's belongings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ印の付いた本体でした。友人も確認したので回収しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 識別後の回収を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The main unit had the same identifying mark. My friend confirmed it too, so I collected it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report collecting it after identifying it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do you have all the parts now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: コードと本体がそろいました。二つをかばんに入れてから移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二部品をそろえ収納して移動する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have both the cable and the main unit. I'll put both in my bag before moving on.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Gather both components, put them away and then move on. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お忘れ物がない状態でお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please continue once you're sure you haven't left anything behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご用件を教えてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所の変更と、子供の通学について相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二種類の相談を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to discuss a change of address and my child's travel to school.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Present two different matters for consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれ担当が異なります。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、住所の窓口から行きます。通学の話は別に取っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 担当別の順序を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'll go to the address counter first. I'll keep the school travel matter separate for later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide the order according to the responsible counters. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 必要な資料も担当ごとに確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the required documents with each department too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この二枚のメモを分けて、共通する住所だけ両方に書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資料を分けて共通情報を記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll separate these two notes and write the shared address information on both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate the documents and record the shared information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通学の相談先もご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll also show you where to ask about travel to school.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前だけでは迷いそうなので、階と窓口番号もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次の窓口の位置を具体的に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I might get lost with just the name, so please tell me the floor and counter number too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask specifically where the next counter is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内図に印を付けますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll mark it on the floor guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。一件終わってから、次の場所へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一件ずつ進めると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll finish one matter before going to the next place.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you'll handle one matter at a time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、まず住所の窓口へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please go to the address counter first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方も一緒にお話しされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will the person with you be speaking with us too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語を手伝ってもらいたいです。症状は私が答えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人が答え友人が言語補助すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like their help with Japanese. I'll answer questions about my symptoms myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you will answer and your friend will provide language support. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 言葉の補助ということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: So they're here to help with the language.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。友人に代わりに判断してもらうわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通訳と代理判断を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I'm not asking my friend to make decisions for me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish interpreting from making decisions on your behalf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どの部分が難しいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Which part do you find difficult?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 質問が長いと分からなくなるので、短く区切っていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 質問を短く区切る配慮を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I lose track when questions are long, so I'd like you to break them into short sections.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request that questions be broken into short sections. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分からないときは、分かったふりをせずに聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 聞き直しの意思を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: When I don't understand, I'll ask again instead of pretending I understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State that you intend to ask again when needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご本人への確認も必要になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll also need to confirm things with you directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の答えを友人に訳してもらい、最後に私も内容を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訳された回答を本人も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll have my friend translate my answers, and I'll check the content myself at the end too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the translated answers yourself as well. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その方法を担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-17210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll pass that approach on to the person in charge.
